verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy is still married to Erica Stoll.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Stoll and McIlroy have been married since 2017, but she filed for divorce in May of 2024. A month later she’d withdraw the petition.' (implies still married); R2: 'All indications are that McIlroy and his wife remain married.'; R4: 'Rory McIlroy is married to Erica Stoll.'; R6: 'The short answer: Yes — McIlroy and Stoll are still together.'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm they are still married after dismissing divorce filing, with recent appearances together.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy filed for divorce on May 13, 2024, in Florida.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'she filed for divorce in May of 2024' (contradicts who filed); R2: 'McIlroy had filed for divorce... in a Florida court last month' (May 2024); R3: 'McIlroy filed for divorce in Florida' (2024); no source specifies 'May 13'.
verifications.reasoning: Most sources support McIlroy filed in May 2024 in Florida, but R1 attributes filing to Stoll (contradiction); exact date 'May 13' omitted across all.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy voluntarily dismissed the petition in June 2024.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A month later she’d withdraw the petition' (contradicts who dismissed); R2: 'filed a motion Tuesday to voluntarily dismiss a divorce petition... June 11'; R3: 'notice of voluntary dismissal was filed'; R4: 'withdrew his petition the following month'; R5: 'voluntarily dismissed his petition'.
verifications.reasoning: Most sources attribute voluntary dismissal in June 2024 to McIlroy, but R1 says she withdrew (contradiction).

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy announced that the couple had resolved their differences and decided to move forward together as a family.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2/R3/R4/R6/R8: 'Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.'
verifications.reasoning: Exact quote from McIlroy in multiple sources directly supports the claim.

verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe them together at 2026 Masters events.

verifications.claim: Documents were filed to dismiss the case in June 2024
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'A month later she’d withdraw the petition' (May filing implies June); R2: 'June 11... filed a motion... to voluntarily dismiss'; R3: 'Shortly after, court records... “notice of voluntary dismissal” was filed'; R5: 'dismissed the petition weeks later'.
